name: Frame Drop Detection
description: Detects frame continuity breaks and drop patterns common in AI-generated 비디오
algorithm: Frame Drop Detection — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method detects anomalous frame drops and timing irregularities for deepfake detection:

1. **FrameTiming분석**: Presentation timestamps (PTS) and decode timestamps (DTS) are analyzed for timing regularity. Authentic video shows consistent frame intervals matching the declared frame rate (±encoder tolerance). Manipulated video may show timing anomalies from frame insertion, deletion, or re-timing.

2. **광학적FlowFrameInterpolationCheck**: Inter-frame optical flow magnitude is analyzed. Dropped frames produce larger-than-expected optical flow between surviving frames (double the normal inter-frame motion). The method detects statistically anomalous flow magnitudes indicating missing frames.

3. **시간적아티팩트감지**: Frame drops produce specific visual artifacts: (a) motion judder (uneven motion appearance), (b) temporal aliasing (fast-moving objects show irregular positions), (c) audio-video desync accumulation. The method detects these artifacts as indicators of temporal manipulation.

4. **SelectiveFrameDrop패턴**: Natural frame drops (from capture issues) are typically random. Deepfake manipulation may show selective frame drops — specifically removing frames containing generation artifacts or temporal inconsistencies. The method analyzes frame drop patterns for non-random distributions correlated with content complexity or face presence.

5. **Re-Timing감지**: Video that has been re-timed (frame rate converted) shows characteristic blend frames or frame selection patterns. The method detects re-timing signatures that may indicate the video has been processed through a deepfake pipeline that outputs at a different frame rate than the source.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through frame drop detection analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
